raw_market.question: Will there be a Rampage at the BLAST Slam VIII Playoffs?
raw_market.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player records a Rampage in any game of the BLAST Slam VIII Playoffs (the LAN Finals held at BLAST Arena Studios in Malta), currently scheduled for October 8 to October 11, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A "Rampage" is a rampage as recognized and recorded in game by Dota 2 (a single player killing all five opposing heroes in succession within the game's rampage window). Only completed official games of the Playoffs stage count (Upper Bracket, Lower Bracket, and Grand Final). Games from the Group Stage, Seeding Matches, and Last Chance stage do not count. Games that are remade or not completed, and games awarded by forfeit without being played, do not count.

This market may resolve to "Yes" as soon as a qualifying Rampage is confirmed in a completed game.

If the BLAST Slam VIII Playoffs are canceled, or are postponed such that they have not concluded by November 10, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No", unless a qualifying Rampage has already occurred.

The primary resolution source for this market will be Datdota (https://www.datdota.com); however, official match data from OpenDota (https://www.opendota.com) and Dotabuff (https://www.dotabuff.com), official broadcast footage, and a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
